body.text: Past 1800px --site-shell steps to 1360px and --section-y to clamp(4rem, 4.5vw, 6rem); the plan deck's orphan-centring rule is scoped to 1024-1799px because above that the deck is four up and a fourth card is not an orphan. The column deliberately stops at 1360px — a wider measure would hurt reading, so a 3840px display keeps large margins by design
